reviews.review:
From the news, I thought it would be ugly SJW crap.  I avoided it for years.

It's a pretty darn good game, with a ton of non-grindy content.  I like it.
so completely asinine that i need to constantly sign in to origin and when you cant sign in you cant play. so stupid.

This isn't a videogame, its an Audiogame.

I played all ME games and wanted to try this one. Despite all the the bad press i still wanted to play it since i love ME.(How bad can it be ,right?)


Welp, i made a mistake. This game is the most boring game i have ever played.(Really i rather play Tetris)

RANT:

Every small little thing takes a huge amount of effort to get done. This game is seriously a chore with little to no reward.

Like you will spend 1h30m on a quest where all you have to do is give a report to someone. Because you will have to visit 3 different planets which will force you through 12 loading screens, you will have run for 30 minutes backtrack for 30min more, and then 15 minutes of a redundant boring speech resuming all about the quest.(That you already know, SINCE YOU WERE THE ONE WHO DID THE QUEST!!!!)

END OF RANT.


-The menus are clunky and unnintuitive.
I mean the menus are so bad that i had to look in the internet how to change weapons, and apparently  lots of people had the same problems as i did.
 

-So many dialogs... Just thinking of how much dialog there is in this game, i could cry...

I usually never skip cutscenes or dialogues since they give meaning to everything to quests, etc... But this game went waaaaay to far.

For every fetch meaningless quest there is this huge speech. Talking of things you already know.
There were times where i pressed an answer option and went to the bathroom, came back 4 minutes later the dude was still talking... sigh...(Dude will you ever shut the F*** UP?) 


- Gameplay. The combat is fine. Problem is you fight the same to enemies from start to finish, which gets... booooring.

While in previous games you fought 6 or 7 type of aliens each of the with their individual traits, in ME Adromeda you fight the same alien race.


-The MAKO. It didnt bother me much appart of being worst tahn the MAKO in ME1. You can't even shoot anything... At least in ME1 the MAKO had a turret and a missile launcher and it was kinda fun to blow enemies away.(But fun is not something youll find in this game.)




[b] TLDR:[/b] One of the worst games i have ever played. Worse than Papers Please.

Good game overall .Nice side missions.

No DLC's. I was expecting  that "wow" element regarding end of the game but i'm little disappointed.

PS: worth buying it only if it's on offer (50-70%) .... and that Origin is totally useless, not to mention that i wanted my achievements on steam, not that annoying app.

The game is very good and engaging. Not as bad as it was mentioned in the negative reviews. ME 1,2 & 3 were well integrated. This is a longer game with good missions & choices. Few task are a grind and these are not game breaking tasks if you miss. The graphics is pretty good except for the eye movement. This again is not spoiling the experience. Had only 2 crashes throughout the entire game play and this is also not game breaking.

The game feels incomplete due to untied ends which the devs could have closed with DLCs. Awaiting some good DLCs but not sure if it will ever come.
